baseline_models.focus_anchor: The accusative عَيْنًا at word 1 and passive تُسَمَّى at word 3 present a source and its received designation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The water-source branch of ع ي ن supplies an issuing flow, while the dominant naming branch of س م و individuates that flow by a publicly usable name.

activation_trace.role: A spring or visibly flowing water-source supplies the concrete entity named by the clause.
Naming as raised designation makes Salsabil the source's established identifying name.

changed_reading.before: A spring happens to have the proper name Salsabil.
changed_reading.after: A flowing source is deliberately individuated by an established designation, so naming is part of how the source is presented rather than incidental ornament.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عَيْنًا can retain visual and self-identifying overtones while تُسَمَّى makes the source recognizable by a sign.
baseline_models.mechanism: Direct manifestation, exact identity, and the split mapped branch of an identifying mark converge: the spring is not only water but a focal entity made legible as this very source.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face manifestation supplies the source's quality of being directly encounterable.
The very thing itself makes the spring a specifically individuated entity.
A visible identifying mark turns the act of naming into legible distinction.

changed_reading.before: The verse supplies a label for an otherwise generic spring.
changed_reading.after: The spring is a manifest focal presence whose exact identity is made readable through its name.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of عَيْنًا and تُسَمَّى permits the named item to be singled out qualitatively, not only denotatively.
baseline_models.mechanism: The choice-part branch of ع ي ن combines with rising and raised designation in س م و; receiving the name elevates this source from one spring among others to a selected source.

activation_trace.role: The choicest part of a thing supplies qualitative selection within the class of springs.
Rising high supplies elevation as the functional effect of singling the source out.
Raised designation provides the naming operation by which the selected source is distinguished.

changed_reading.before: Salsabil differentiates one spring by vocabulary alone.
changed_reading.after: The designation also ranks or honors the spring as a choice source.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concrete source عَيْنًا and the split mappings carried by تُسَمَّى can meet in the image of an opening through which liquid is regulated.
baseline_models.mechanism: An eye-hole in a waterskin converges with the non-dominant narrow-opening and stoppering branches mapped from س م و. The resulting focus-only model treats the spring as a controlled outlet rather than only a natural pool.

activation_trace.role: The eye-like thin spot in a waterskin supplies a liquid-bearing outlet.
The split branch's narrow opening supplies the aperture through which the source can issue.
Stoppering and tightening supply the complementary possibility of regulating that outlet.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts an unstructured natural spring.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it depicts an eye-like aperture whose opening and closure make water available in a controlled way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins embodied human life with a mixed drop and later places a mixed cup immediately before the named spring. The focus source becomes the terminal water pole of a composition sequence running from human formation to rewarded drinking.

activation_trace.role: Clear water ranging from a drop to a sea supplies the fluid material of human origin.
Mixing makes the originating drop explicitly composite.
Mixing one thing with another repeats composition in the cup immediately before the focus.
The focus's flowing source supplies the named water-origin to which the later mixture is attached.

structural_cues: 76:2 orders fluid, mixture, testing, and perceptual capacity at human origin.
76:17-18 orders cup, mixture, and named source at the reward scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two fluid-mixture sequences; I supply the lifecycle arrow that makes the later source answer the originating mixed drop. They may alternatively be independent compositional descriptions.

changed_reading.before: Salsabil is an isolated amenity in the reward scene.
changed_reading.after: Salsabil is the named terminal source in a fluid anthropology that begins with mixed embodied origin and returns to a mixed drink.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier spring is drunk from and actively made to burst forth. Its exact عَيْنًا parallel strengthens the focus's water-source reading while changing the source from static scenery into abundant, beneficiary-operable flow.

activation_trace.role: Taking in liquid establishes the earlier spring as usable drink rather than scenic water.
The repeated spring branch directly links the earlier issuing source to the focus noun.
Wide splitting and emission give the source an actively opened, distributable flow regime.
The focus repeats the flowing water-source that receives this operational profile.

structural_cues: 76:6 and 76:18 repeat the same accusative noun عَيْنًا.
The cognate pair يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا intensifies deliberate release in 76:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier operable spring and a later named spring; I transfer the earlier hydraulic affordance to the focus. The two springs may instead remain referentially and operationally distinct.

changed_reading.before: The named spring is a fixed water feature.
changed_reading.after: The named spring participates in an abundant distribution system whose flow can be opened and directed for its drinkers.

context_deltas.mechanism: People direct food outward while refusing repayment or thanks; the reward sequence then directs drink toward them and explicitly calls their striving thanked. The spring becomes material reciprocity whose direction reverses their earlier one-way provision.

activation_trace.role: Recognition of favor and praise names the return that the feeders explicitly decline from recipients.
Feeding another supplies the initial outward transfer of sustenance.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit reciprocal frame.
Giving drink until the recipient is watered reverses the direction of service toward the earlier feeders.
Work and earned action identify the human conduct that is finally declared appreciated.
The focus spring supplies the material source through which reciprocal provisioning is realized.

structural_cues: 76:8-9 moves food from the righteous to vulnerable recipients and negates requested recompense and thanks.
76:12 and 76:17-22 move recompense, drink, and acknowledged striving back toward the righteous.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored transfers and explicit reward language; I supply the directional reciprocity arrow that makes the focus spring part of the return. The drink can alternatively be adjacent reward without mirroring the feeding act.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a luxurious object within a reward catalogue.
changed_reading.after: The spring is a medium of returned provision: unreciprocated feeding is answered by being given drink from an inexhaustible source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audible shape of سَلْسَبِيلًا stands between the surah's سَبِيل and سَلَاسِل. Their inventories supply a traversable road, connected rings, and smooth running or drinking. The proper name can therefore function as a counter-name that converts obstructive linkage into continuous route and flow.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversable road supplies the first path pole heard within the focus name.
The repeated traversable road brackets the focus with a path that can be taken toward the Lord.
Smoothness in running and drinking supplies the positive flow latent in the chain root's branch inventory.
Connected rings supply the punitive linkage that the focus name can reverse rather than erase.
The spring gives the sound reversal a concrete medium of running and drinking.
Naming as designation lets the acoustic reversal operate through the proper name itself.

structural_cues: The packet text exposes the surface echo among سَلَاسِلَا, سَبِيل, and سَلْسَبِيلًا without assigning the focus name a root.
Punitive chains occur before the reward scene, while a voluntarily taken path recurs after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the surface echo and all three branch images; I assume the proper name is heard against those neighboring forms and assign the reversal arrow. It may alternatively remain an opaque name with accidental resemblance.

changed_reading.before: Salsabil is an opaque proper label for a spring.
changed_reading.after: Salsabil is a counter-name in which linked constraint is re-formed as smooth drinking and an open route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate serving scene specifies vessels, silver, glass, and exact measure before moving through cup and mixture to the spring. That material network activates the focus-only eye-hole, narrow-opening, and stopper model as a calibrated outlet in a designed drink system.

activation_trace.role: A containing vessel supplies the drink system's bounded component.
Silver supplies the specified material from which the vessels are made.
A glass bottle supplies transparency and a definite liquid container.
Measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies calibration of capacity and delivery.
The focus eye-hole supplies a small liquid outlet analogous to a waterskin opening.
The split narrow-opening branch turns the named source into an aperture within the material system.
Stoppering and tightening add controlled closure to the outlet mechanism.

structural_cues: 76:15-18 is an uninterrupted progression from serving vessels to their measure, cup, mixture, and source.
The focus locative فِيهَا does not itself say that the spring is inside a vessel.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated containers and focus branches for apertures and closure; I treat the adjacency as one engineered serving system. The live alternative is a natural landscape spring merely served from those vessels.

changed_reading.before: The spring is independent landscape scenery beside the serving vessels.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the spring is the calibrated release point that completes a precisely measured vessel-and-flow system.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the named reward source, the surah commands voiced remembrance of the Lord's name and calls itself a reminder. This recasts Salsabil's designation as a name meant to remain verbally and mentally available, not merely a label inside a pictured scene.

activation_trace.role: Mention flowing on the tongue supplies voiced persistence for names beyond the scene in which they occur.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the mnemonic frame around the promised source.
Name as raised designation repeats the focus's naming operation in an imperative devotional setting.
The passive designation in the focus provides the particular name carried into remembrance.
A visible identifying mark makes the remembered name a sign by which the promised source is recognized.

structural_cues: The command وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ in 76:25 follows the reward vision rather than preceding it.
76:29 classifies the discourse as a تَذْكِرَةٌ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated naming and remembrance after the focus; I infer that the named spring can function mnemonically for the present hearer. The alternative is that divine-name practice and the spring's proper name are unrelated uses of naming.

changed_reading.before: Salsabil identifies a future object only within the depicted garden.
changed_reading.after: Salsabil is also a remembered verbal sign that lets the future source exert force in present naming practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden brings shade and fruit near, makes produce easy after difficulty, and later offers a path that can be taken. These spatial and kinetic cues make the focus spring part of a low-friction topology that approaches the beneficiary instead of remaining a remote landmark.

activation_trace.role: An extended traversable road supplies directed access rather than static location.
Nearness supplies the environment's movement toward its inhabitants.
Making easy after difficulty supplies reduced effort at the point of use.
The focus spring becomes the water access point embedded in that accommodating space.

structural_cues: 76:14 brings shade and fruit down toward the inhabitants before the drink-serving sequence.
76:18 locates the spring فِيهَا, internal to the accommodating environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, facilitation, path, and an internal spring; I infer a shared accessibility design. The spring could alternatively remain reachable without inheriting the fruit scene's lowered-effort mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The name marks a spring somewhere within the garden.
changed_reading.after: The spring is an access point in a space designed to bring sustenance near and remove friction from reaching it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر ء ي to ر و ي split and lets thirst-quenching color repeated verbs of seeing. It remains anchored in the focus's genuine eye/spring polysemy and the immediate repetition of sight after 76:18; downstream prose should present it as a cross-branch convergence, not as morphology or a lexical equation between seeing and drinking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَيْنًا is simultaneously branch-citable as a seeing eye and a water spring, directly before repeated رَأَيْتَ forms.

activation_trace.role: The seeing eye supplies the perceptual pole of the focus noun.
The flowing spring supplies the thirst-answering pole of the same focus noun.
Repeated seeing by eye and insight intensifies the perceptual scene immediately after the spring.
The split branch's quenching of thirst lets the repeated sight scene function as visual satiation.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a water object subsequently looked at within the scene.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is the scene's eye: a focus where looking and being sated are made to coincide.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it routes focus س م و through و س م's first-rain mark and treats naming materially. It remains anchored in the focus spring, its naming verb, and the packet's garden, fruit, and green-growth branches; downstream prose should call it an ecological material analogy, not the lexical sense of تُسَمَّى.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The named عَيْنًا joins a water source to a naming root whose supplied split inventory includes rain that marks earth with growth.

activation_trace.role: Cloud and lasting rain extend the focus water-source toward landscape-forming water.
First rain marking earth with vegetation makes naming legible as a water-made trace.
A garden hidden by trees supplies the larger vegetated surface on which the water-mark appears.
Pickable fruit and near clusters supply visible productivity downstream of water.
Fresh green growth supplies the color and life by which the spring's material mark can be read.

changed_reading.before: Salsabil is a spoken proper name attached to water.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the source writes its name into the garden as fruiting and greenness, so designation becomes an ecological trace.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it carries spring hydraulics into the later descent, recitation, and remembrance sequence. It remains anchored in the focus's flowing source and explicit naming construction, while 76:23-25 supplies descent, voiced text, and voiced remembrance; downstream prose should frame it as an analogy between kinds of delivered provision, never as identity between Salsabil and the Qur'an.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَيْنًا supplies flowing provision and تُسَمَّى supplies an utterable designation that can be carried into the later discourse sequence.

activation_trace.role: The issuing spring supplies the hydraulic image for delivered provision.
Name as raised designation supplies the focus's verbal and repeatable side.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient supplies downward delivery.
Reading and recitation supply the delivered discourse's oral flow.
Mention moving on the tongue extends that oral delivery into repeated remembrance.

changed_reading.before: The named spring belongs only to the material inventory of the garden.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, it prefigures provision that descends, reaches its recipient, and continues to flow through recitation and remembrance.

strongest_changes: The exact earlier عَيْنًا plus drinking and forceful release changes the focus from static scenery into abundant operable flow.
Feeding without requested return followed by recompense, watering, and thanked striving makes the spring a medium of reversed provision.
The surface convergence of سَلَاسِلَا, سَبِيل, and سَلْسَبِيلًا lets the name reverse linked restraint into smooth drinking and route.
The opening mixed drop and the later mixed cup make the source the terminal water pole of a whole-surah composition arc.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus name function across remote repetitions rather than only inside 76:17-18: an earlier operable spring, chains and paths, one-way feeding and returned drink, creation mixture and reward mixture, later sight, remembrance, and measured vessels each changed what kind of source Salsabil could be.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether the springs of 76:6 and 76:18 are referentially linked or only structurally parallel.
The chain-to-path reading depends on treating surface sound inside a proper name as an intentional activation rather than coincidence.
The aperture, visual-satiation, and growth-mark models depend on non-dominant mapped branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The reciprocal reading supplies a causal and directional arrow to a sequence that could instead list adjacent rewards.
